in_marathi.name: Renjith
in_marathi.long_meaning: Renjith हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Renjith is a Tamil and Malayalam name which is derived from the Tamil word 'Ren', meaning 'Lord' and the Tamil word 'Jith', meaning 'Vishnu'. It is a powerful name that signifies the presence of Lord Vishnu in a person's life.
